channelMetadataRenderer.title: The Dissenter
channelMetadataRenderer.description:
My name is Ricardo Lopes, and I’m from Portugal. Thank you for visiting my channel.

Over the past few years, I have conducted and released more than 1100 interviews and talks with experts and academics from a variety of areas and disciplines, ranging from the Arts and Philosophy to the Social Sciences and Biology. You will certainly find a subject of your interest covered here.

New interviews are released on Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays.
